def seal(r):

for label,mutation in [("positive",None),("null",None),("bool",False),("object",{}),("string","contract.records-empty"),("element-bool",[True]),("element-int",[1]),("element-object",[{}]),("element-list",[[]]),("unknown",["contract.records-nonempty"]),("duplicate",["contract.records-empty"]*2),("foreign-procedure",None),("wrong-source",None),("wrong-schema",None),("old-pin",None),("input-empty",None),("input-status-bool",None),("input-status-float",None),("input-records-object",None),("empty-probe",None)]:

    sections=json.loads(payload["text"])

    elif label=="empty-probe": p["probe"]=[]
    elif label.startswith("input-"):

        def replace(value):
            if type(value) is dict:

                return {k:replace(v) for k,v in value.items()}

        sections=replace(sections)
